primaryFinding.whyRedundant: For a valid current configuration with sourcePresetId punctum-default but no old legacy strings, no callbacks modify next, changed stays false and the cloned object is discarded. This repeats on fresh dynamic public SSR requests; React cache is not a durable cross-request snapshot.
primaryFinding.minimalBehaviorPreservingFixProposal: Keep safeParseSiteConfig, migration, fallback, legacy replacement checks and all published semantics. Use a lazily allocated cloned draft: let next: SiteConfig | undefined; function edit(apply: (draft: SiteConfig) => void) { next ??= structuredClone(config); apply(next); }. Replace callbacks that currently write nextHome/next with writes to edit(draft) only after a matching condition. Return next ? siteConfigSchema.parse(next) : config. Ensure the special legacy typography and heroMedia rewrite also allocate lazily. Avoid a global cache or changes to Studio draft/revision logic.
